metadata.title: Clicked like I was trying to open a door and got a kill? Valorant pls wtf?!
metadata.description:
Me: just smashing buttons like it’s a vending machine
Enemy: “Wait, what just happened?”
Valorant throwing random kills like it’s free candy
Click if your aim’s more accident than skill!

Tap if you’ve ever killed by pure dumb luck!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
